subject: general
question: Cigarette smoking is harmful to our health because ______.

options.text: it reduces the oxygen - carrying capacity of RBCs
it damages the cilia in the upper respiratory tract

solution:
The correct answer is __**it damages the cilia in the upper respiratory tract**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cigarette smoke contains harmful chemicals that damage the cilia, **tiny hair-like structures in the upper respiratory tract.
 
• T**hese cilia help to clear mucus and debris from the lungs.**
 
• When damaged, the cilia become less effective, leading to increased mucus buildup and potential respiratory infections. 
 
• **The harmful effects of cigarette smoking on the cilia in the upper respiratory tract:**
 
 
• **Cilia impairment:** The chemicals in cigarette smoke, such as tar and nicotine, can damage or paralyze the cilia.
 
• **Mucus buildup:** With impaired cilia, mucus can accumulate in the lungs, creating a breeding ground for bacteria and other harmful microorganisms.
 
• **Increased risk of infections:** The buildup of mucus can lead to respiratory infections like bronchitis and pneumonia.
 
• **Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD):** Long-term damage to the cilia and lungs can contribute to COPD, a serious lung disease characterized by difficulty breathing.
